card.name: Digit 1 starting two-digit section numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 1 that begins a two-digit number, mostly a label section number (12.x, 14.x, 17) inside a bracketed cross-reference like [see Clinical Studies ( 14.1 )]. It also fires on the 1 starting two-digit numbers in dates and dose tables.

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: The 1 that opens a section number such as 12, 14 or 17 inside a 'see ... (' reference.

modes.label: Other two-digit numbers
modes.description: The 1 starting a date or table value, where another digit must follow.

card.writes: It promotes the digits 2 through 9, so it predicts the next digit of the number.
card.plain: It marks a leading 1 in a number like 12 or 14 and prepares the model to write the second digit.
